name: logic-only-unit
prompt: write e2e tests for the discount rules in src/pricing.js: 10% over 1000, members get 5% more, never more than 15%. cover all the edge cases. plan first please.

graders.name: right level
graders.criteria: PASS if the reply says the discount rules are pure logic best covered by unit tests (all the edge cases there) and limits end-to-end to at most one or two journeys through the cart UI. FAIL if it plans to cover all the discount edge cases with end-to-end browser tests.
